events.description: Jill Goodacre says the time Jill Goodacre spent with Chandler Bing during the blackout has been fun.
Chandler Bing says Jill Goodacre let Chandler Bing use Jill Goodacre's phone.
Chandler Bing says Jill Goodacre saved Chandler Bing's life.
Jill Goodacre says Jill Goodacre had a great time during the blackout with Chandler Bing.
Jill Goodacre says Jill Goodacre will see Chandler Bing later.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing's bank account number is 7143457.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing does not know whether the bank recorded any of the earlier conversation between Chandler Bing and Jill Goodacre in the ATM vestibule during the blackout.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing would like the bank to provide a copy of the ATM vestibule security camera tape.
